arguments.command:
python -c "
from datetime import timedelta
import humanize

# Test with max timedelta (largest valid one)
max_td = timedelta.max
result1 = humanize.naturaldelta(max_td)
print(f'naturaldelta(timedelta.max) = {repr(result1)}')

# Test naturaltime with max timedelta
result2 = humanize.naturaltime(max_td)
print(f'naturaltime(timedelta.max) = {repr(result2)}')

# Test huge but within limits
huge_td = timedelta(days=999999999)  # Just at max
result3 = humanize.naturaldelta(huge_td)
print(f'naturaldelta(huge_td) = {repr(result3)}')

# Test negative huge
neg_huge = -huge_td
result4 = humanize.naturaldelta(neg_huge)
print(f'naturaldelta(-huge_td) = {repr(result4)}')

result5 = humanize.naturaltime(neg_huge)
print(f'naturaltime(-huge_td) = {repr(result5)}')
"
